f02_dimensions_only.dxf.why: dimension annotation only; a dimension's extension lines are not walls

f03_text_only.dxf.why: room names and a title with no geometry

f07_dwg_renamed.dxf.why: a binary DWG saved with a .dxf name

f08_unsupported_entities.dxf.why: 3D faces, meshes and points only; nothing a plan reader can use

f09_inconsistent_units.dxf.why: header says millimetres, geometry is metre-sized; must never build a 9 mm house

f10_mixed_scales.dxf.why: the same plan at two scales; the small copy must not become a building

f12_untitled_repeated_plans.dxf.why: two identical plans, no titles: storeys or neighbours cannot be told apart

f13_superimposed_plans.dxf.why: overlaid partitions from another storey; must stay one level, never two buildings
